anna-docs: Quick heads-up — opened PR to add a tracing hook example to Console Observability docs and a short migration note for the dashboard rename. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/482

mike-console: nice, can you paste the code snippet you're planning to add? want to check it matches the tracing hook API

anna-docs: sure, planning to include this minimal example:
```js
// server middleware
app.use(async (req, res, next) => {
  const trace = tracing.start('redwood.console.request')
  await next()
  trace.tag('route', req.path)
  trace.finish()
})
```

priya-eng: small suggestion — add an example of adding a custom attribute for model_id. Otherwise LGTM.

anna-docs: good call, will add `trace.tag('model_id', modelId)` after the request handler comment. Also adding a short note about latency breakdowns per-route in the console dashboards.

jeff-ml: Also include the cost breakdown snippet we use in the console: `cost = tokens * model_price_per_token + infra_surcharge` — maybe a tiny table example.

anna-docs: adding a tiny table and a callout: "estimates only, billing uses usage pipeline". Also adding migration section: dashboards renamed from "Inference Overview" -> "Model Insights" — will add mapping list.

mike-console: can you include a redirect link so old docs link doesn't 404? we have `/docs/dashboard-migration` route.

anna-docs: yup will add a short 301 redirect and update the sidebar. Pushing an update in a minute.

mike-console: pinging @priya-eng for a quick API accuracy check on the tracing snippets

priya-eng: reviewed inline, pushed one tiny wording change. LGTM from me :thumbsup:

anna-docs: thanks! updated PR with the tag addition and table. Ready for merge after any final console owner check.

mike-console: I'll check headers and sidebar. If no blockers I'll merge today.
